title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
abstract: arXiv:2610.28788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. translated_title: ArcFlow：面向多求解器预算的流策略训练
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28788v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：流匹配策略通过求解器的步数来调节推理成本，但在单一固定求解器预算下进行强化学习，可能会掩盖在更低成本部署预算下的性能退化，甚至会抹除预训练策略中已有的一步推理能力。我们提出了动作比率裁剪流，这是一种面向部署的算法，用于在指定的求解器预算范围内训练单一的流策略。ArcFlow 结合了动作对齐监督、预算暴露和最差预算检查点选择三项技术。对于重建目标，其桥接机制将时间探针聚合为每个动作对应的一个代理比率和一个 PPO 风格的裁剪，且其边界残差精确等于部署时的一步重建误差。循环训练使共享的场暴露于整个部署预算范围，而检查点选择机制则优化其性能下限。对于原生速度目标，多预算端点监督在无需替换原生形式的情况下应用了相同的原则。
tldr: 提出 ArcFlow 部署感知算法，通过动作对齐监督、预算循环暴露和最差预算检查点选择，在多个求解器预算范围内训练单一流匹配策略，避免单一预算强化学习导致的低成本部署性能退化。
en_tdlr: ArcFlow is a deployment-aware algorithm that trains a single flow-matching policy across a range of solver budgets through action-aligned supervision, budget cycling, and worst-budget checkpoint selection, preventing performance degradation at cheaper deployment budgets.
